open_semantic_defects.title: Capitalized Stealth grant is applied but covers no models
open_semantic_defects.source_authority: coverage.json: hash-verified retained full Core body; unchanged adopted rows
open_semantic_defects.constructed_rule: This unit gains Stealth until the end of the phase.
open_semantic_defects.expected: A successfully applied unrestricted unit grant covers every model in the rules unit, for each permitted keyword class.
open_semantic_defects.actual: The compiler accepts the rule, execution reports APPLIED, but stealth_source_inventory returns an empty covered-model set for all four native definition controls.
open_semantic_defects.cause_evidence: The parsed GRANT_ABILITY parameter retains Stealth, while the Stealth consumer matches lowercase stealth. Lowercase controls cover all native models.
open_semantic_defects.observed: 4 failed, 4 lowercase controls passed; no skip/xfail and no semantic engine edit.
open_semantic_defects.future_fix_scope: Review canonical ability-token handling at parser/execution/consumer boundaries and retain case-variant integration controls. Do not fix as part of the remaining corpus sections.

repaired_execution_crashes.repair: First determine whether a clause grants this exact unconditional permanent Action permission. Skip unrelated abilities. Retain strict source-ID equality for actual grants.
repaired_execution_crashes.after: Native Action eligibility and interruption continue; a matching explicit typed permission succeeds; a drifted actual permission still raises.
